job.title: Heavy Diesel Mechanic
job.description:
About AIM Recruitment Solutions
AIM Recruitment Solutions is a specialist recruitment agency connecting experienced professionals with leading employers across Australia’s transport, logistics, automotive, heavy vehicle and industrial sectors.

We are currently partnering with an established passenger transport operator to recruit an experienced Heavy Diesel Mechanic / Heavy Vehicle Mechanic to join their workshop team in Kyneton, Victoria.

If you’re a qualified Diesel Mechanic, Heavy Vehicle Technician, Truck Mechanic or Bus Mechanic looking for a secure, long-term opportunity in the Kyneton / Macedon Ranges region, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role
This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified Heavy Vehicle Diesel Mechanic to join a professional workshop responsible for maintaining a safe, reliable and operational passenger transport fleet.
Reporting to the Workshop Manager, you will undertake heavy vehicle servicing, diagnostics, repairs, preventative maintenance and fault finding, helping maximise fleet reliability and vehicle availability.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform preventative maintenance, scheduled servicing, inspections and repairs on heavy vehicles
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, braking, suspension, drivetrain, cooling and engine systems
  • Complete fault finding and diagnostics using specialised equipment and tools
  • Carry out repairs and maintenance across a diverse heavy vehicle fleet
  • Maintain accurate service records, job cards and workshop documentation
  • Conduct vehicle safety inspections and ensure compliance with WHS requirements
  • Assist with breakdown repairs and general workshop activities
  • Maintain high standards of workmanship, safety and vehicle reliability
About You To be successful, you will ideally have:
  • Certificate III in Heavy Commercial Vehicle Mechanical Technology, Automotive Mechanical Technology (Heavy Vehicle), or equivalent
  • Previous experience as a Heavy Diesel Mechanic, Heavy Vehicle Mechanic, Truck Mechanic, Bus Mechanic or Heavy Vehicle Technician
  • Experience servicing and repairing trucks, buses, coaches or other heavy vehicles
  • Strong mechanical diagnostic and fault-finding skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a workshop team
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship
  • Current Australian driver’s licence
  • Heavy vehicle licence highly regarded
What’s On Offer
  • Secure, long-term Heavy Diesel Mechanic opportunity
  • Established passenger transport operator
  • Competitive remuneration based on skills and experience
  • Professional and well-supported workshop environment
  • Monday-to-Friday opportunity (if applicable – definitely include this if true)
  • Ongoing training and development
  • Diverse heavy vehicle fleet
  • Kyneton location – ideal for candidates across the Macedon Ranges and surrounding areas
How to Apply If you’re an experienced Heavy Diesel Mechanic, Heavy Vehicle Mechanic, Bus Mechanic or Truck Mechanic looking for your next opportunity in Kyneton, click APPLY NOW.

A consultant from AIM Recruitment Solutions will contact shortlisted candidates for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Toolmaker / CNC Operator
job.description:
About Us
AIM Recruitment Solutions is a trusted recruitment agency with nearly 20 years of experience, proudly supporting top-tier employers along the Eastern Seaboard. We are dedicated to connecting skilled individuals with rewarding roles that align with their experience, career goals, and long-term ambitions.
 
About the Opportunity
We are currently recruiting on behalf of a well-established and respected supplier to the Australian mining industry for an experienced CNC Programmer / Machinist – Milling to join their manufacturing team.

Currently based in Sunshine, the business will be relocating to Airport West at the end of July.

The successful candidate will be primarily responsible for the manufacture of CNC machined components for tools, jigs and fixtures used throughout the manufacturing process, supporting the changing requirements of a diverse client base.

This position would suit an experienced CNC Programmer/Machinist or Toolmaker who is confident programming using CAM, setting and operating CNC milling machines, and producing precision tooling components from start to finish.

Hours & Rate
Monday – Thursday: 6:00AM – 2:30PM
Friday: 6:00AM – 12:00PM
Rate: $45.00 – $50.00 p/hr, based on experience and skillset
Key Responsibilities Your responsibilities will include:
  • Writing CNC programs using CAM
  • Setting up and operating CNC milling machines
  • Setting up tooling and workpieces and trialling CNC programs
  • Preparing and setting up workpieces ready for machining
  • Setting multiple workpiece coordinates and tool lengths
  • Selecting and setting appropriate tooling for each job
  • Monitoring tool condition and replacing tooling as required
  • Completing in-process and final inspection of CNC machined components
  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings and manufacturing specifications
  • Performing regular maintenance checks on CNC machinery
  • Troubleshooting and adjusting machinery as required
  • Operating manual machines when required
  • Assembly and maintenance of tooling as directed
  • Providing skilled support across the Engineering, R&D and Production Teams
  • Effectively managing multiple tasks and priorities while maintaining a high standard of workmanship
  • Maintaining a safe, organised and positive working environment
CNC Tooling Manufacture You will be involved in manufacturing CNC components for a variety of tooling applications, including:
  • Open cast tooling
  • Compression mould tools
  • Injection mould tools
  • Jigs and fixtures
  • Other specialised tooling components used throughout the manufacturing process
Exposure to or experience with EDM wire-cutting will also be highly regarded.

Qualifications & Experience To be successful, you will ideally bring:
  • Demonstrated experience in CNC programming and milling
  • Strong CAM programming capability
  • Previous CNC machine setup and operating experience
  • Toolmaking or precision manufacturing experience
  • Experience manufacturing tooling, jigs and fixtures highly regarded
  • Ability to confidently set workpieces, coordinates and tool lengths
  • Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings
  • Experience completing precision measurements and inspections
  • Manual machining experience
  • EDM wire-cutting experience highly regarded
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within Engineering, R&D and Production teams
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality
Benefits
  • $45–$50 p/hr, dependent on experience and skillset
  • Permanent day-shift hours
  • Early finish every Friday – 12:00PM
  • Long-term opportunity with an established Australian manufacturer
  • Varied CNC work across tooling, jigs and fixtures
  • Opportunity to work across Engineering, R&D and Production
  • Supportive and team-focused working environment
  • Sunshine location, relocating to Airport West at the end of July
How to Apply
If you're an experienced CNC Programmer/Machinist who enjoys the complete process – from CAM programming and machine setup through to machining, inspection and finished tooling – we'd love to hear from you.

Click “APPLY NOW” to submit your application and a member of the AIM Recruitment Solutions team will be in touch.

Don't miss this opportunity to join a respected and growing Australian manufacturer!
